capabilities: Browse vault folders as visual channels and blocks
Render image thumbnails, markdown text previews, and filetype badges
Drag files from the desktop into channels
Reorganize files by dragging blocks between channels
Fetch link titles and cover art for pasted URLs
disambiguation: Not a web browser or an Are.na sync tool; it renders local vault folders as visual channels and blocks.
extras: Makes outbound network requests for URL metadata, Spotify/SoundCloud oEmbed, and optional Apify screenshot fetching (only with a build-time APIFY_TOKEN); states it collects no analytics or telemetry. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes desktop and mobile previews.
problem: Obsidian's file management is text-based, with no visual board for browsing, previewing, and reorganizing files by dragging them between folders.

relations.evidence: for links from open.spotify.com and soundcloud.com, the plugin calls the platform's public oEmbed endpoint
calls the platform's public oEmbed endpoint to retrieve the cover thumbnail URL

summary: Visual file browser that renders vault folders as Are.na-style channels and file blocks with thumbnails and previews.
